nordvpn.name: NordVPN
nordvpn.description:
NordVPN is arguably the most recognizable VPN on the market, offering exceptional speeds, robust security features, and a strict no-logs policy. Whether you want to bypass geo-restrictions for streaming or protect your data on public Wi-Fi, NordVPN is the ultimate all-rounder.

With over 6,000 servers across 111 countries, you'll never struggle to find a fast connection. It includes advanced features like Threat Protection (blocking ads and malware) and Double VPN for ultimate privacy.
cons: Map-based interface can be clunky on smaller screens
Renewal prices are higher than introductory rates

expressvpn.name: ExpressVPN
expressvpn.description:
ExpressVPN focuses on delivering an incredibly straightforward, premium experience with arguably the most reliable unblocking capabilities in the industry. While it comes at a premium price point, the consistency of its speeds and the simplicity of its apps make it a favorite for beginners and power users alike.

It features the proprietary Lightway protocol, ensuring rapid connections without sacrificing security. If you want a VPN that 'just works' every time, this is the one.
pros: Incredibly easy-to-use apps for all devices
Consistently bypasses tough geo-blocks (Netflix, BBC iPlayer)

surfshark.name: Surfshark VPN
surfshark.description:
Surfshark disrupted the VPN market by offering premium features at a budget-friendly price, along with the rare benefit of unlimited simultaneous connections. You can protect your entire household's devices with a single subscription.

Despite the low price, it doesn't skimp on features, offering MultiHop, a clean web blocker, and excellent streaming unblocking capabilities. It's the absolute best value VPN available today.
cons: Some servers take a few seconds longer to connect
Customer support can be slow occasionally
